item.title: PUNGENT STENCH to Re-Issue “For God Your Soul… For Me Your Flesh” on March 20th
item.description: Pungent Stench have announced the re-issue of their 1990 classic For God Your Soul… For Me Your Flesh via Hammerheart Records. The remastered version will be released on 20th March, 2026 and comes with 10 bonus tracks, liner notes, lyrics and pictures.
